description: Turn two weeks of symptom logs into a one-page pre-appointment brief your doctor will actually read.
notes: Brief generator aggregates logs into printable one-pager; add-symptom modal works
shared/kit.js + kit.css empty at build time; full Kit fallback inlined

notes.note: Doctors get 15 minutes and patients bring shoeboxes — the one-page brief is a real productivity unlock. Weakest assumption: anyone pays recurring for it. It's a per-visit artifact, and per-visit artifacts don't sustain subscriptions; this wants to be a feature of portals or a per-brief purchase.
Tabs switch; generated one-page brief + severity trend render, zero errors.

notes.change: Doctor-side annotation (README next-3 #2): Addressed/Follow-up toggles on each brief question, persisted. Also killed the dead nav action (now a working About button) and fixed the add-symptom modal (onClick->fn: it never logged before).
